issues.description: The problem statement and template require implementing PersonService.addParent(Person person, Person parent), and the REST layer/tests call personService.addParent(...). However, the solution repository does not implement addParent; it implements the parent-registration logic under the different method name registerParent(Person, Person). This makes the reference solution inconsistent with the specified API and would not compile with the provided PersonResource/test code that expects addParent.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename solution method registerParent(Person person, Person parent) to addParent(Person person, Person parent) (same signature/behavior), or add an addParent(...) wrapper delegating to registerParent(...), and keep all callers (PersonResource/tests) using addParent as specified.

issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to adapt a build script named build.sh or build.bat for deployment, but neither the template nor the solution repository contains these files. This causes a missing-artifact mismatch: students are told to edit/run files that are not present.
issues.suggestedFix: Add build.sh and build.bat to the template (and solution, if used as reference) with appropriate placeholder commands, or update the problem statement to reference the actual script/file(s) provided for building and deploying.
